claims.description: Custom properties inherit, cascade, and resolve before supported layout declarations are parsed.
conditions: Custom properties inherit from ancestors and local declarations override inherited values.
Forward references resolve independently of declaration order.

notes.text: Parity covers inherited and locally overridden variables used directly and in reducible calculations across dimensions, margin, padding, gap, flex, grid, and positioning declarations.

claims.description: Nested fallbacks recover missing, invalid, and cyclic custom property references.
conditions: Fallback values may contain nested `var()` references.
Every custom property participating in a reference cycle is invalid.
A consuming declaration can recover an invalid custom property with its own fallback.

notes.text: Parity covers nested missing-value fallbacks and a consuming fallback for cyclic custom properties.
A supported declaration whose `var()` reference remains unresolved routes through the configured unsupported CSS policy instead of contributing an incorrect layout value.
